payload.description:
High quality material: The kitchen roll holder with great design made of natural high quality beech wood is robust, durable and easy to clean. Thanks to the elegant graining a real eye-catcher in your kitchen. So you can combine design and functionality in the kitchen with the kitchen towel holder.

Unique design: The simple and practical design of the kitchen roll holder makes your kitchen worktop look elegant and modern and easy to install. Small balls can prevent paper towels from being scattered.

Perfect size: 31 cm x 13 cm. The kitchen roll holder is suitable for most standard and large rolls. Use in kitchens, semi-bathrooms and anywhere with limited storage space.

Non-slip design: The bottom of the kitchen roll holder is equipped with 4 non-slip pads, strong and stable, and can be easily placed on the table.
